title: Accelerate Bench: Evaluating Agents for Application-Level Program Optimization
abstract: arXiv:2611.20882v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Application optimization requires coding agents to discover useful changes and coordinate them across a complete program while preserving the required computation. We introduce Accelerate Bench, a benchmark of 32 CPU optimization tasks adapted from scientific applications and supercomputing competitions. Each task provides a working program and specifies the workload, correctness requirements, timing boundaries, and permitted edits, leaving agents to choose where and how to optimize. Public testing supports iterative development, and a separate verifier scores the final submission. On benchmark version 1.1, we evaluate 16 coding agents, each pairing a model with a harness. Their Score@1 ranges from 25.5% to 67.4%. Most of their programs are correct, and the size of the speedup separates them: the two leading agents are at least 2x faster on 22 or more of the 32 tasks, while the other fourteen reach 2x on 8 to 17 and leave 125 of their 41

translated_title: Accelerate Bench：评估应用级程序优化智能体的基准测试
translated_abstract: 应用优化要求编程智能体发现有效的改动，并在保持所需计算的前提下，将这些改动协调地应用于完整程序中。我们提出了Accelerate Bench，这是一个包含32个CPU优化任务的基准测试，任务改编自科学应用和超级计算竞赛。每个任务提供一个可运行的程序，并规定了工作负载、正确性要求、时间界限和允许的修改范围，由智能体自行决定在何处以及如何进行优化。公开测试支持迭代开发，并由独立的验证器对最终提交结果进行评分。在基准测试1.1版本上，我们评估了16个编程智能体，每个智能体由一个模型与一个执行框架配对组成。它们的Score@1得分介于25.5%到67.4%之间。大多数智能体生成的程序都是正确的，而加速比的大小将它们区分开来：两个领先的智能体在32个任务中的22个或更多任务上实现了至少2倍的加速，而其他14个智能体仅在8到17个任务上达到2倍加速，并在其41……
tldr: 该论文提出了Accelerate Bench基准，包含32个改编自科学应用和超算竞赛的CPU优化任务，用于评估编程智能体在应用级程序优化上的能力，发现各智能体的程序大多正确，但真正拉开差距的是所实现的加速比大小。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces Accelerate Bench, a benchmark of 32 CPU optimization tasks adapted from scientific applications and supercomputing competitions to evaluate coding agents on application-level program optimization, showing that while most agents produce correct programs, the magnitude of speedup achieved is what separates them.
